title: Skill frontmatter
description: Shape of the YAML frontmatter block in skills/<name>/SKILL.md, per docs/skill-anatomy.md. This is the machine-checked mirror of that doc's rules -- docs/skill-anatomy.md stays the authoritative explanation of *why* each field exists. Two rules this schema can't express and that scripts/validate-skills.js still checks by hand: `name` must match the containing directory name (cross-file, not expressible per-file), and `description` should contain a 'use when...'-style trigger phrase (a heuristic, not a hard shape rule).

allowed-tools.description: This repo's convention is a YAML list, a deliberate divergence from the agentskills.io spec's documented space-separated-string form -- see docs/skill-anatomy.md. Only the list form validates.
